attributions.title: Add fractions with unlike denominators

exercise.instruction: Add each pair of fractions. Give every answer in lowest terms.

paragraphs: Find a denominator both fractions can use.
Rename each fraction without changing its value.
Add the numerators and keep the shared denominator.
lesson.title: The three moves

steps: Rewrite both addends as equivalent fractions.
Add the numerators and reduce if needed.
workedExample.title: One half plus one third

accessibility.summary: Fraction addition problem: 1 over 4 plus 1 over 2.

hints.text: Find the least common multiple of 4 and 2.
Rewrite both addends as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

misconceptions.description: Adds the numerators without first finding a common denominator.

printFallback.text: Draw equal fraction bars for both addends, partition them into the least common denominator, then combine the shaded parts.

prompt.accessibleText: Add 1 over 4 and 1 over 2. Give the answer in lowest terms.
prompt.instruction: Add each pair of fractions. Give every answer in lowest terms.

solutionTrace.explanation: Use 4 as the least common denominator.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator.

solutionTrace.accessibleText: 3 over 4 is already in lowest terms.
solutionTrace.explanation: Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms.
